d: Long, straight jet black hair with blunt-cut bangs and side-swept locks flows down the back. The golden-amber eyes are narrow and focused behind thin-framed glasses, set on a youthful, mature face. The slender build is dressed in a white and lime-green lab coat over a black dress with a white chest panel, black tights, and white open-toe heels. Signature details include a white headset with a singular side-piece and two floating, glowing circular holographic disks of white and light blue.
